family_summary: Copy on the AI-built pages is almost uniformly plain, descriptive wording, whereas the originals show more varied voices (user-generated titles, exclamatory CTAs, quirky lowercase with emoji); most other copy details (footer lines, orthography, emoji) were reproduced identically where observed, with differences in h1 text, title formats, gloss formatting and meta lines.

attributes.summary: All 4 AI-built pages use plain sentences (and the one page checked for emoji has none), while the originals vary across plain sentences, user-generated thread titles, exclamatory CTAs and lowercase quirky copy with emoji, with only one original being plain and the one checked original also lacking emoji.
On the single site observed, the AI-built footer reproduces the original's logo with 2021 copyright line and the VerticalScope/XenForo credit unchanged.
AI-built pages give the h1 visible text (a two-line title, the site name or a tagline) on all 3 sites, whereas two originals have empty or logo-image h1s and only one uses site name text.
On both sites the AI-built page titles follow a different pattern from the originals (hashtag instead of tagline, brand prefix plus forum name instead of topic plus forum name).
The one AI-built thread meta line reads 'posted by, reply count' and shows no relative timestamps, whereas the original shows user, time and replied time with relative times in time elements.
The AI-built page keeps the original's diacritics and glottal marks but formats English glosses as bold terms with parentheticals instead of the original's slash-joined style.
Three AI-built pages each add a copy element (separate gendered occupation cards, a goal line with progress image, trailing text arrows on links) with no counterpart recorded on the originals.
